title: Causal Step — Source-technical extraction and comparison contract v0.1
status: PROPOSED SCHEMA; source abstraction and test-suite design only, not a tested general formal equivalence
aim: Make cross-domain physics models mechanically comparable at the level of dynamic relational operations, while separately recording externally justified mathematical/physical claims.

mandatoryPaperModelRecord.originalTitle: Required full paper title and original authors (names verified)

exactMathLocator: definition number / equation number / page numbers; not merely a DOI

modelScope.physicalClaims: exact claim and current independent evidence, not implication of topic title
modelScope.formalDomain: which state-space subset / initial conditions / automorphism quotient / algebra assumptions
modelScope.relevantCounterexample: at least one source negative or counterexample, if available

types: e.g. nodes, hyperedges, ports, cells, edges, tensor states, charges, maps
labelsAndSymmetries: renaming of nodes, environment, gauge/references, orientations

eventEnablement: complete guards, not just diagram adjacency
transitionRule: exact equation or algorithm, including read/write/delete/create operations
compositionRule: commutation/conflict/higher-order coherence, not only pairwise tensor

mappingToNativeCausalStep.representationMap: native event occurrence -> source model typed action, declared or absent
mappingToNativeCausalStep.equivalenceRelation: exactly what observational/intervention content must be preserved
mappingToNativeCausalStep.reverseRecoveryOrCounterexample: proof, exact finite witness, or failure
mappingToNativeCausalStep.statefulInterferenceAndTripleComposition: must account for T4 83 state-sensitive pair signatures and 660 blocked triples
independentNulls: pairwise-only matching with different higher-order response
same scalar entropy/homology but different events

observables: actual paper predictions, uncertainty and data sources
negativeTests: known contrary observations and systematic degeneracies

nativeSourceReferenceRecordExample.formalDomain: 7 selected frozen rule contexts, k=3/4/5 observational scopes, node bit vectors, distinct unordered hyperedge occurrences; not an underlying physical arity/dimensional bound.
nativeSourceReferenceRecordExample.sourceEventEnabling: Full-rank edge occurrence is eligible iff alive, unfired, and sum(source bits) belongs to the rule's allowed Hamming weights.
nativeSourceReferenceRecordExample.sourceEventEffect: Mark fired; may remove from alive set; mutate source bits according to original selected mutation; produce one newborn with state determined by rule and input weight; create offspring hyperedges at allowed ranks consisting of newborn and selected old participants.
nativeSourceReferenceRecordExample.actualNoMetric: No initial metric, Hilbert state, actual force, mass, field or physical dimension is present in this frozen source.
sourceKnownFailures: Every fired step forces a newborn, so node growth is not independent emergence
660 initial pairwise commuting triples can fail to compose
k5/#81 periodic FIFO local tail and k4/#21 scheduler dependence
nativeSourceReferenceRecordExample.technicalFidelity: source code and T1–T4 exact finite tests exist; no external physical equivalence achieved

processRule: Every new source-comparison claim must cite its object, equation/operation, exact assumptions, transfer map and negative controls. A matching shape at the diagram/abstract level is only a candidate.
premetricBoundary: Do not define fundamental graph distance, dimensionality, time parameter, energy, entropy or quantum state just to make existing physics formulas true.
